label: Town of Dover
header:
# Town of Dover municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 7; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Dover Selectboard members: Victoria Capitani (Chair), Sarah Shippee (Vice Chair), Daniel Baliotti, Patrick Lagrange, and Joseph Mahon.
Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists the same five.

Town of Dover official election results, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (doververmont.com): records Patrick Lagrange re-elected to a 3-year term (81 votes) and Daniel S. Baliotti re-elected to a 2-year term (79 votes) on March 3, 2026.

Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster seats Capitani (Chair, expiring 2027), Shippee (Vice Chair, 2027), Baliotti (2028), Mahon (2028), and Lagrange (2029).
Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Andy McLean as Town Clerk, elected to a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Andy McLean as Town Clerk of Dover.
Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Marco Tallini as Town Treasurer, elected to a 3-year term expiring 2028.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Marco Tallini as Town Treasurer of Dover.
Town of Dover official election results, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (doververmont.com): records Richard J Werner re-elected Moderator for 1 year on March 3, 2026 (83 votes).
Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster names Richard Werner as Town Moderator.

Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Tamara Allen (term expiring 2026), Michelle Pinkham (2027), and Robert A. McIntyre (2028).
Town of Dover official election results, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (doververmont.com): records Tamara Allen re-elected Auditor for a 3-year term on March 3, 2026 (90 votes).
Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster names the same three auditors (printing 'Robert McIntyre Jr.').
Town of Dover official election results, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (doververmont.com): records Andy McLean re-elected First Constable for 1 year on March 3, 2026 (89 votes).
Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Andy McLean as 1st Constable.
Town of Dover official election results, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (doververmont.com): records Marco Tallini re-elected Trustee of Public Funds for a 1-year term on March 3, 2026 (88 votes).

Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Marco Tallini as Trustee of Public Funds. Dover fills the office with a single trustee on 1-year terms, so the post carries one seat.
Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster lists the Delinquent Tax Collector among the town's APPOINTED officers: Marco Tallini.
Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the APPOINTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Andy McLean as Grand Juror.
Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster likewise lists the Grand Juror among the appointed officers: Andy McLean.
Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the APPOINTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists Linda Holland as Town Agent.
Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster likewise lists the Town Agent among the appointed officers: Linda Holland.

Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists five Library Trustees on 5-year terms: Diane Guminak (expiring 2026), Laura Maturo (2027), Kathleen Saccoccio (2028), Richard Payan (2029), and Roger Cardinal (2030).

Town of Dover official election results, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (doververmont.com): records Debra Malloy elected to a 5-year Library Trustee term (86 votes) and Shital Kinkhabwala elected to the 5-year term with two years remaining (86 votes) on March 3, 2026.

Town of Dover Town Officer Appointments page (doververmont.com, current): the current roster seats Malloy, Kinkhabwala (expiring 2028), Maturo, Payan, and Cardinal; Guminak and Saccoccio rotated off at the 2026 meeting and are not recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Dover justices of the peace: Timothy Dolan, Linda Holland, Catherine Kaufmann, Chelsea Samani, and Shannon Wheeler.

Town of Dover 2026 Town Report (Annual Report 2024-2025) (doververmont.com): the ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS table lists the same five justices of the peace (printing Linda L. Holland and Catherine D. Kaufmann).
